_doc: Karmi Laven multi-buy price ladders + shipping: the ONE table the server charges from (api/_pricing.js) and /api/stock serves as `ladders`. Pool key = 'gradient' (The Gradient Edit barcodes, api/_gradient.js) or a single price in pence as a string (every product whose WAT till single price equals it shares that pool, whatever its family). A product whose price has no pool here gets NO multi-buy: n x its single price. All amounts are integer pence. Change prices/steps/shipping here only; see docs/LADDERS.md. THIS DEFAULT = the live behaviour on 23 Nov 2026 (Gradient 1/2/3/5; no family multi-buy; free UK shipping from £12.00 or 5+ items, else £1.49; no cart rules; no new bag progress line).
